wins: Achieved positive total reward (+60) in the single episode
Completed the episode without termination errors
fails: Overall success rate was 0% despite positive reward
Only one episode executed, limiting statistical confidence
key_outcomes.summary: The run produced a positive reward but failed to meet success criteria. More episodes and clearer success-oriented actions are needed to validate performance.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Reward gained without meeting defined success criteria

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial reconnaissance is required against an unknown host
skill_cards.then_action: Run fast TCP port scan to identify open services

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP/HTTPS is detected on common ports
skill_cards.then_action: Perform web enumeration to discover directories and technologies

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH is detected on port 22
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate SSH configuration and supported auth methods

memory_ops.reason: Base reconnaissance is foundational and likely contributed to positive reward.
Web enumeration is a common next step when HTTP is present.

next_experiments.title: Increase episode count
next_experiments.description: Run 10+ episodes with identical settings to establish reliable success metrics and reduce variance.

next_experiments.title: Success-criteria alignment
next_experiments.description: Instrument the agent to explicitly pursue defined success conditions (e.g., privilege escalation or flag capture) after reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Recon-to-exploit handoff test
next_experiments.description: Add a rule-based handoff from service discovery to targeted exploitation (e.g., HTTP -> CVE checks, SSH -> credential audit) and measure success impact.
